senses.gloss: m. (זגג) bell, the body of the bell, contrad. to עינבל, clapper.
units: Naz. VI, 1 כז׳ של בהמה (zag means the shell) like the bell of an animal; החיצון ז׳ וכ׳ the outer part is called zog, the inner inbol.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 1:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. I, 13</cite> <he>ז׳ של דלת</he> door-bell.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 5:5">Tosef. Sabb. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:7">VI</cite>), 7, sq.; <cite ref="Shabbat 58a:16">Sabb. 58ᵃ</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זוּגִּין</he>, <he>זֻגִּין</he>. Tosef. Kel. l. c. <he>העושה זג׳ וכ׳</he> he who fastens bells to a mortar. Ib. 14 <he>חזקת ז׳ וכ׳</he> the rule concerning bells &c.

Y. Gitt. III, 45ᵃ top זו׳ bells (among the appurtenances of siege, v. כַּרְכּוֹם II); Y. Keth. II, 26ᵈ דוגין (corr. acc.). Tosef. l. c. [read:] אמר לאומן עשה לי שני ז׳ אחד לדלת וכ׳ if one says to the artisan, Make for me two bells, one for a door &c.; Y. Gitt. III, 44ᵈ top (corr. acc.); a. fr. [זוּגִּין grape-shells, v. זָג.]
